tasks.content: UPDATE apps/monjournal/docs/how/architecture.md to reflect the current implementation in apps/monjournal/app/src/. Key changes to document: (1) ThoughtsContext replaces useThoughts hook as primary state management, (2) New screens added: HelpScreen, DemoScreen, AboutScreen at routes /help, /demo, /about, (3) Enhanced components: InlineAddThoughtForm, ControlZone, DateRangePicker, TagInput, TagMultiSelect, (4) MSW integration for mock API, (5) Global error handling with ErrorBoundary. Read the current codebase files to verify actual implementation before updating. Preserve existing sections that remain accurate. Update the Component Hierarchy section, Routing section, and State Management section. Do not overwrite completely—incrementally update to reflect current state.

CREATE apps/monjournal/docs/how/c4/components.md with a C4 Components diagram using Mermaid. Document the internal component structure of the MonJournal React application. Include components: HomeScreen, AddThought, HelpScreen, DemoScreen, AboutScreen, InlineAddThoughtForm, FilterPanel, ThoughtList, TimelineView, TagInput, ControlZone, and their interactions. Reference apps/monjournal/docs/how/c4/containers.md for context. Include title frontmatter 'title: MonJournal Components' and a descriptive H1 header. Use the template from .agents/skills/oneticket-c4 for reference.

CREATE apps/monjournal/docs/how/c4/deployment.md with a C4 Deployment diagram using Mermaid. Document how MonJournal is deployed and runs. Include: static web browser container, browser with React SPA, localStorage within browser, and any build/hosting infrastructure. MonJournal is a static SPA with no backend—deployment is simple (static file hosting). Include title frontmatter 'title: MonJournal Deployment' and a descriptive H1 header. Reference apps/monjournal/docs/how/architecture.md section 14 for deployment details.

CREATE apps/monjournal/docs/how/slices/slice-5-help-screen/slice.md documenting the Help screen feature. This screen provides user guidance and documentation within the app. Include: overview of what the help screen does, technical scope (route /help, component HelpScreen), modules (HelpScreen.tsx), acceptance criteria, testing strategy, and related epics/user stories. Read apps/monjournal/app/src/screens/HelpScreen.tsx to understand what it displays. Use template from .agents/skills/oneticket-doc-structure. Include proper frontmatter with title 'Slice 5 — Help Screen'.

CREATE apps/monjournal/docs/how/slices/slice-6-demo-screen/slice.md documenting the Demo screen feature. This screen demonstrates MonJournal with sample data. Read apps/monjournal/app/src/screens/DemoScreen.tsx and apps/monjournal/app/src/utils/sampleThoughts.ts to understand implementation. Use template from .agents/skills/oneticket-doc-structure. Read apps/monjournal/app/src/screens/AboutScreen.tsx to understand what is displayed. Use template from .agents/skills/oneticket-doc-structure.
